blocking_reason: The current replay implementation already fills a completed-bar signal at the next bar Open. The frozen baseline does not provide a distinct Same-Bar Close control, so the preregistered comparison cannot be executed without redefining its control.
missing_next_bar_rule: NO ENTRY; not evaluated because run blocked

replay_kbars.finding: Each current row sets last_tick.close from current Open, then passes previous completed K-bar to process_completed_kbar.

local_market_order_fill.finding: Local market order uses last_tick.close as fill reference.

required_to_unblock: Establish a valid same-bar-close control baseline and register a reviewed experiment definition; do not reinterpret this blocked experiment after seeing performance.

historical_poc_fill_audit.read_scope: Training 2023-2024 only; execution timing identity audit, not performance evaluation
historical_poc_fill_audit.finding: Existing POC trade timestamps are earliest-entry/next-bar timestamps, and all 248 matched fills equal that entry bar Open. Thus the historical POC artifacts do not provide a distinct Same-Bar Close control. In 163 cases signal close happens to equal next-bar Open, so price equality alone can be ambiguous.
